title: ScoreStream 1.1 parsed core AST
description: Validates parsed structure, not the raw SFS text. A semantic validator is still required.

Rational.description: Canonical reduced rational string. Reduction is checked semantically.

Attributes.description: Flat values. The language registry checks names, types, scopes and extension requirements. Unknown unqualified fields fail semantic validation.

title.description: Plain score text, never markup or a filename fallback. Optional; an empty string is explicit empty text.

source_description.description: Plain description of the score source, never an instruction or a resource to fetch.

language.description: Plain score text, never markup or a filename fallback. Optional; an empty string is explicit empty text.

authors.description: Ordered plain author names. Empty or absent means no generic author list; legacy role fields remain separate.

display_name.description: Optional plain authored part label, independent of instrument identity. Absence uses the instrument as a renderer fallback; an empty string is an explicitly empty label. Text must contain only XML 1.0 characters.

then.description: Finite-decimal exact NoteOn percent of forte90; this note only. Zero is retained. Runtime validates note owner and exact finite decimal domain.
Requires scorestream.navigation@1; exact ownership/time, field pairing and route restrictions are checked semantically.
Requires scorestream.grace@1 and a pitched unmeasured grace anchor. Exact ranges, same-frame placement, group order and one mark per grace are validated semantically.

Requires scorestream.instrument@1: one initial record at zero per part, unique source ID and matching IDREFs, catalog projection and exact value ranges are semantic checks. MIDI intent is authored only.

Requires scorestream.beam@1 in a complete score. Exact onset, actual measure ownership, written flags, full per-lane topology and the separate authored-grace capability for grace anchors are checked semantically. Legacy beam relations cannot be mixed with authored beam marks.

Requires scorestream.articulation@1 and at least one mixed measured pitched host. Explicit ordered child references retain wrapper boundaries, empty wrappers, and group order. Each group and every ordinary tied phase, authored slur endpoint and single fermata must occur exactly once. No legacy articulation overlap, dangling or duplicate reference, gapped index, foreign field or new tie semantics. Tied stop precedes start. Mixed ties require native endpoints without sound/print overrides; graphic-only, sound-only, continue engraving, let-ring and repeat-conditioned XML ties remain unsupported. All optical and performance paths fail closed until separately qualified.

Requires scorestream.credits@1, time zero, contiguous unique indices, finite-decimal coordinates and positive finite-decimal font size. Authored-only page text; no renderer or audio interpretation.
Optional authored dynamics coordinates must be finite-decimal exact rational tenths. These do not change symbol, placement, sound assignment or playback, and are not a layout realization promise.
